title: Lost carb entry by 2.8.2 after using calculator
body:
I entered a meal of 24g carbohydrates using the bolus calculator.  As my blood sugar continued to rise over the next few hours, I noticed that the insulin release had been entered, but an entry for the carbohydrates was missing.  this set TBR0 and therefore the BZ rise.  maybe this should be tested somehow
